Good question. You actually don’t need to pair it with much.
Your easyplant already comes with slow-release fertilizer in the soil, so it’s set for about the first 12 months. After that, you can add a liquid houseplant fertilizer diluted to 1/4 strength when refilling the reservoir.
The only other thing you might use later is a light top-up of soil if it settles. Coco coir or a light indoor potting mix works well.
So in short: water, occasional fertilizer after a year, and that’s basically it.
